data.title: 德尔塔 · 暖冬午后的绒毯求摸肚皮
data.description: 暖炉火光跳动的温馨客厅绒毯上，德尔塔穿着毛绒狗狗卫衣四脚朝天地仰面躺着。毛茸茸的犬耳微颤，大尾巴在身后欢快拍打地面，两只小手搭在软软的肚皮上，眼巴巴地哼唧着求摸肚子。
data.location: cozy living room hearth rug with crackling fireplace
data.action: lying on back on a thick fur rug, exposing tummy, hands curled playfully near chest, dog tail thumping rug, eager pleading amber eyes, adorable open-mouth puppy grin
data.lighting: warm flickering fireplace glow blended with soft afternoon window sunlight
data.mood: irresistible pet girlfriend cuteness, playful puppy affection, warm domestic bliss
data.promptProse: Lying playfully on her back on the living room rug wearing a fluffy hoodie, dog-girl Delta curls her tail happily and begs for belly rubs with an adorable fanged smile.
data.animaCaption: Lying on her back on the cozy hearth rug, she wags her tail and begs for belly rubs with an adorable fanged grin.
